subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘ARC' is coded as '1-18-3' and 'BOY' is coded as '2-15-25'. What is the code for ‘FAD’ in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Position value according to the English alphabetic series is written. So, • ‘ARC' is coded as '1-18-3'
